methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: AI Ready Roanoke evaluates use for new technology in Roanoke Valley - Roanoke Times
signals.signal_reading: AI Ready Roanoke represents intentional capacity-building in a non-metro region, suggesting peer networks and local institutions can catalyze distributed depth beyond traditional tech hubs if resourced properly.

signals.title: Amazon bows to local backlash over AI data centers, scraps plans to build four new facilities in Northern Virginia — site to be repurposed for mixed-use and residential development. - Tom's Hardware
signals.signal_reading: Amazon canceling data centers due to local backlash reveals infrastructure concentration without community buy-in creates resistance rather than capability diffusion, potentially stalling even concentrated AI development.

signals.title: VCU partners with the Better Business Bureau to bring AI support to Central Virginia businesses - VCU News
signals.signal_reading: VCU-BBB partnership bringing AI support to Central Virginia businesses signals platform-mediated shallow adoption spreading beyond NoVA, but through external expertise delivery rather than indigenous capability building.

signals.title: Norfolk Public Library to teach people about AI - KCAU 9 News
signals.signal_reading: Public library AI education in Norfolk demonstrates grassroots knowledge distribution infrastructure activating in a military-adjacent region, potentially seeding peer learning networks among non-tech workers.

signals.title: Google revealed as company considering Roanoke County site for data center - Virginia Business
signals.signal_reading: Google eyeing Roanoke for data centers signals infrastructure concentration following cheap power rather than workforce depth, risking extractive development that deepens the gap unless paired with local capability investment.
